summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Hephaestus killed with missiles of red-hot metal in the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Mimas among the Giants whom Hephaestus felled with missiles of red-hot metal when the gods, with Heracles' aid, destroyed the earthborn brood. Mimas is one of the Giants named in that battle roll.
